rationale: The reporter asks for a new capability: inspect the dependency tree of a package without installing it (like pipgrip). That is a feature request, not a bug or usage confusion. Searches found no earlier issue with the same request; the results were unrelated. A maintainer might point to existing workarounds such as `uv pip compile` on a one-line requirements input, but that is a design choice, so I kept the type as enhancement. I did not read the docs, so I did not check whether an existing command already covers this.
